skills.name: rajutara-dev
skills.description: Build, test and extend the rajutara workspace: gates, crate map, adding a tool, command, pane, file field or translated string.

skills.name: rajutara-core-model
skills.description: The domain model and its invariants with exact type names: Style, Piece, Contour, SizeTable, GradeRule, Marker, Order, CutPlan, ids, units, validation.

skills.name: rajutara-io
skills.description: Import and export recipes for ASTM/AAMA DXF, RUL, HPGL/2, PDF, CSV and native files, with ImportIssue handling and fixtures.

skills.name: rajutara-nesting
skills.description: Use and tune the nesting engine: Stop modes, seeds, determinism, reading reports, the 300-piece gate and ESICUP benchmarks.

skills.name: rajutara-headless
skills.description: Drive rajutara without a screen: --smoke under Xvfb, the tshirt_sample example, the end-to-end test, scripting the crates and the zip+JSON documents.

skills.name: rajutara-operator
skills.description: Assist a workshop Operator in Optitex vocabulary: PDS, Grading, Marker and Cut Plan workflows, shortcuts, importing a graded ASTM file, making a marker, planning a cut order.

skills.name: rajutara-clean-room
skills.description: The ADR 0001, 0002 and 0013 rules to obey when extending rajutara: no Optitex files, no GPL code, RUL is an open format.
